purpose: Define deterministic pre-rendered carousel rotation sampling so alternating canopy stripes remain visually coherent in 2D runtime animation.

sampling.sampleAngles: frame n uses (n-1)*7.5 degrees for n=1..48

colorMask.synchronization: mask frame and beauty frame must use the same direction, frame index, pivot and canvas

validation: recolor plus fixed stripe counts must equal 24
exported frame 48 must represent 352.5 degrees, not 360 degrees
frame 49 exists only as the non-exported loop closure key
beauty and color-mask spritesheets must have identical frame ordering
